sheets.name: ui_controls_01
sheets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game UI sprite atlas. Use supplied image ONLY as a style reference. Draw NEW original icons. Match thick rough BLACK GRAPHITE contours, waxy colored-pencil grain, simple slightly irregular silhouettes, warm ochre, brick red, blue and leaf green fills, angular off-white SCISSOR-CUT paper sticker border. Paper border follows each object closely. Bold shapes readable at 16 to 32 pixels. No watercolor, engraving, smooth vectors, glossy 3D, metal frames, outer shadows, decorative background. TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA outside each sticker. No text or numbers or labels or grid lines. EXACTLY 5 columns by 4 rows of equal cells on a square canvas. One centered sticker in each cell. Each sticker occupies ONLY middle 72% of its cell, with generous transparent gutters. Read subjects left to right, top to bottom.
Row 1: bold green plus sign; blue left-pointing arrow; single black downward chevron; single black right-pointing chevron; bold red X cross.
Row 2: bold green checkmark; four dark pencil corner brackets around a tiny folded map; small clock encircled by a backward arrow; three bold horizontal dark graphite dots; red drawing pin.
Row 3: two blue circular arrows chasing each other; one ochre backward curved arrow; cream document with a red bookmark and quill; round brass clock face with two dark clock hands, no numbers; ivory dice with dark pips.
Row 4: red and ivory bullseye with arrow; large dark pencil question mark; eye crossed by a red diagonal stroke; ochre triangle with dark exclamation mark; cream ledger report with three drawn horizontal lines and red binding.
